articles.title: Guía para obtener 15 GB de espacio gratis en Google Drive, Gmail y Google Fotos
articles.text:
Disponer de espacio de almacenamiento en la nube es esencial para la vida digital actual. Google ofrece de forma gratuita 15 GB a cada usuario, repartidos entre Google Drive, Gmail y Google Fotos. Sin embargo, muchos pierden la oportunidad de aprovechar al máximo este beneficio por no conocer cómo se distribuye o gestiona este espacio.
Cuando la cuota se agota, surgen mensajes de error, imposibilidad de recibir correos y la tentación de pagar por ampliaciones. Saber cómo liberar y administrar estos 15 GB sin gastar dinero es más importante que nunca.
PUBLICIDAD
En la era del trabajo remoto, las tareas escolares digitalizadas y el intercambio constante de archivos, el almacenamiento gratuito en Google se transforma en un recurso clave. Aunque en un principio 15 GB pueden parecer suficientes, la acumulación de archivos, fotos, videos y adjuntos termina por saturar la cuenta en menos tiempo del esperado.
La buena noticia es que, con una gestión adecuada y una limpieza periódica, es posible seguir usando el plan gratuito y mantener bajo control el espacio ocupado.
PUBLICIDAD
¿Qué significa tener 15 GB gratuitos en Google?
Es un error común pensar que cada servicio de Google tiene su espacio individual. En realidad, los 15 GB se comparten entre Google Drive, Gmail y Google Fotos. Esto significa que un exceso de archivos en cualquiera de estos servicios afecta al resto. Por ejemplo, un buzón de Gmail repleto puede bloquear la subida de archivos a Drive, aunque allí haya espacio disponible.
La clave está en entender que el “truco” consiste en administrar y liberar espacio de manera inteligente. No se trata de descubrir promociones ocultas, sino de aprovechar de forma eficiente la cuota ya asignada a cada cuenta.
PUBLICIDAD
Paso 1: Identificar y eliminar archivos más pesados en Google Drive
El primer avance en la recuperación de espacio se consigue localizando los archivos más voluminosos. Google Drive permite ordenar los elementos almacenados por tamaño, facilitando la tarea de identificar videos, respaldos antiguos, instaladores o PDFs que ocupan mucho espacio.
Acciones recomendadas:
- Ingresar a la sección de almacenamiento de Drive y ordenar los archivos por tamaño.
- Revisar los más pesados y eliminar los que ya no sean necesarios.
- Mover los archivos no deseados a la papelera y, después, vaciarla para liberar espacio de forma efectiva.
Es importante recordar que si solo se envían archivos a la papelera pero no se vacía, el espacio no se libera de inmediato. Tras vaciar la papelera, la recuperación de espacio suele completarse en minutos.
PUBLICIDAD
Paso 2: Gestionar el espacio ocupado por Gmail
Los correos con adjuntos grandes y la acumulación de mensajes antiguos suelen ser responsables de gran parte de la saturación del almacenamiento. Muchos usuarios eliminan archivos de Drive pero siguen sin espacio libre porque el problema está en el buzón de correo.
Sugerencias para localizar correos que ocupan mucho espacio:
- Usar el filtro “has:attachment larger:15M” para encontrar correos con adjuntos de gran tamaño.
- Buscar términos como “factura”, “contrato”, “video”, “zip” o “adjunto” para localizar mensajes pesados.
- Tras eliminar correos, vaciar también la papelera y la carpeta de spam, ya que estos correos siguen ocupando espacio hasta su eliminación definitiva.
Paso 3: Optimizar fotos y videos en Google Fotos
En la mayoría de las cuentas, las fotos y videos representan el mayor consumo de espacio. No siempre es necesario borrar, también se puede optimizar.
PUBLICIDAD
Recomendaciones:
- Activar el modo “Ahorro de almacenamiento” en Google Fotos para reducir el tamaño de los archivos automáticamente.
- Descargar las imágenes y videos más importantes a un disco externo y luego eliminarlos de la nube.
- Borrar fotos y videos duplicados o poco relevantes.
Paso 4: Mantener la organización para evitar futuros problemas
Una limpieza puntual resuelve el problema momentáneamente, pero la verdadera solución está en mantener la cuenta organizada.
Buenas prácticas para el futuro:
- Revisar la carpeta de Drive cada mes o cada trimestre.
- Eliminar duplicados y versiones anteriores de archivos.
- Subir solo aquellos archivos que realmente se necesitan y borrar los temporales tras su uso.
Aprovechar los 15 GB gratuitos en Google Drive, Gmail y Google Fotos depende de una gestión consciente y regular del espacio. Con una revisión periódica de archivos grandes, una limpieza en Gmail y una optimización de fotos y videos, es posible mantener la cuenta operativa sin necesidad de pagar por más almacenamiento.
PUBLICIDAD
Unos minutos de mantenimiento al mes pueden hacer que este beneficio gratuito rinda mucho más y evite contratiempos en el trabajo, los estudios y la vida digital cotidiana.

articles.title: Panic passes Trump tariff refunds back to the Playdate customers who paid them
articles.text:
Panic, the indie game publishers behind the quirky, yellow crank-sporting Playdate gaming handheld, is issuing refunds to customers who had to shoulder the cost of inappropriate tariffs imposed by the Trump administration this year.
The news comes months after the Supreme Court said in a February ruling that those tariffs were illegal, which also demanded that the administration refund the companies that had to temporarily pay the import taxes. In an update posted on the Playdate help site this week, Panic noted that it has finally “begun to receive refunds of the tariffs we paid in the last year” and had consequently “refunded all tariffs charged to customers.”
In the initial version of that tariff note, Panic explained that it couldn’t afford to simply “absorb” the 19 percent tariffs it was being charged to import Playdate hardware made overseas because “our margins on Playdate are low.” As such, while the tax was in effect, it was passed along to customers as an explicit subtotal line item at the bottom of all Playdate orders. That’s in contrast to companies like Nintendo, which vaguely cited “market conditions” and tariff “uncertainty” in raising the asking price of legacy hardware and some Switch 2 accessories last year.
Speaking to Game Developer, Panic co-founder Cabel Sasser said filing paperwork to claw back these taxes and processing tariff refunds for customers took a fair bit of backend work. Still, he said returning that money to Playdate purchasers in the end was a no-brainer. “It’s just not our money to keep, and it felt really good to give it back,” Sasser said. “That’s an easy way to know you made the right decision.”

articles.title: ID. California Cruise : voici le premier van aménagé électrique de Volkswagen basé sur l’ID. Buzz
articles.text:
C’est en 2022 que le Volkswagen ID. Buzz voit le jour, sous la forme d’un étonnant van familial électrique. Ce dernier est également décliné en fourgon pour les professionnels et en une variante GTX sportive que nous avions pu essayer. En revanche, il n’y a jusqu’à présent jamais eu de version van aménagé. Pourtant, le projet était bien dans les cartons du côté de la marque allemande. Mais des contraintes liées au poids l’ont contrainte à jeter l’éponge. Une aubaine pour certains équipementiers, qui ont lancé leurs propres kits sur mesure.
Mais le constructeur basé à Wolfsburg n’avait en réalité pas dit son dernier mot, loin de là. Alors que les vacances estivales touchent à leur fin, Volkswagen veut encore un peu les prolonger. Il dévoile pour cela dans un communiqué officiel son tout nouvel ID. California Cruise. Il s’agit du tout premier van aménagé électrique de la marque, basé sur l’ID. Buzz. Ainsi, celui-ci en reprend le look et le poste de conduite. Mais il s’enrichit de nombreuses autres fonctionnalités exclusives.
À bord, ce nouveau venu intègre un grand lit pour deux personnes mesurant 2,03 mètres de long pour 1,20 mètre de large. Un matelas pliant de 9 centimètres d’épaisseur est également inclus. De plus, les voyageurs pourront profiter de grilles d’aération intégrées aux vitres avant ainsi que de stores occultants. Deux chaises et une table de camping sont aussi livrées avec le véhicule. Un store occultant pour le toit en verre est également proposé en option.
Jusqu’au 31 Août, le LUBA mini 2 AWD 1500 perd 300 € ! Sans fil périmétrique, 360° LiDAR & double caméra IA, pente 80%, DropMow, auto cartographie… Bref, elle a tout ce qu’il faut pour vous permettre de ne plus jamais tondre votre pelouse !
Attention à ne pas s’emballer : cet ID. California Cruise n’a rien d’un California « complet ». Pas de cuisine intégrée, pas de toit relevable et seulement deux couchages, là où un California Ocean en propose quatre. On reste ici sur un aménagement d’entrée de gamme, sans doute pour contenir à la fois le poids et la facture.
Tout le confort nécessaire
Par rapport à la version standard, cet ID. California Cruise s’offre une unité de commande supplémentaire, qui permet de régler certaines fonctions d’éclairage et de confort. Il est alors notamment possible de gérer le chauffage ou la climatisation, pour une utilisation prolongée jusqu’à 48 heures.
Par ailleurs, les ports USB sont aussi alimentés en continu, même lorsque le véhicule est éteint. Ce qui est utile pour recharger son smartphone la nuit. Pour ceux qui veulent se préparer un petit café au réveil, le van est aussi livré avec la charge bidirectionnelle V2L.
La puissance nominale atteint 2 000 kW tandis qu’elle peut aller jusqu’à 3,6 kW maximum. Le véhicule prend aussi en charge la fonction Plug & Charge sur les bornes, et l’application Volkswagen Véhicules Utilitaires fait désormais office de planificateur d’itinéraire.
Il faut savoir que cette nouvelle variante reprend la fiche technique de l’ID. Buzz, puisqu’elle est basée sur la version Pro, avec un empattement court ou long. Il est donc possible de choisir entre une batterie de 79 et 86 kWh, avec une autonomie comprise entre 443 et 481 kilomètres WLTP.
Il faut compter environ 30 minutes pour passer de 5 à 80 % à une puissance maximale de 185 kW. Le van revendique 286 chevaux et peut atteindre 340 chevaux avec une transmission intégrale. Mais il faudra attendre pour savoir si cette configuration sera aussi disponible.
En Allemagne, ce nouvel ID. California Cruise est affiché à partir de 60 761 euros. Les premières livraisons devraient démarrer dès le début 2027, tandis que la gamme va encore s’enrichir d’ici à 2028.
En France, Volkswagen n’a pas encore dévoilé sa grille tarifaire. Les commandes doivent ouvrir cet automne, pour des premières livraisons attendues début 2027. Le tarif hexagonal devrait se situer dans les eaux des 60 761 euros allemands, une fois la fiscalité et les équipements de série pris en compte.

articles.title: 'We want to enable as much self-expression as possible, without losing the essence of the characters' — Rockstar reveals new GTA 6 narrative and gameplay details, including the option to seamlessly swap between Jason and Lucia whenever you want
articles.text:
New GTA 6 details reveal a 'Bonnie and Clyde-type' narrative, life sim systems, and the ability to seamlessly swap between Jason and Lucia during gameplay
Jason has been revealed to be ex-military, and Lucia is an amateur fighter
- Grand Theft Auto 6 will let you play as both Jason and Lucia, or individually
- The game will also feature interactive systems that affect their weight and appearances
- Rockstar says that while these features will give players a lot of freedom, "these characters aren’t empty avatars that you can do whatever you want with"
New Grand Theft Auto 6 details have been revealed, giving fans a fresh idea of what to expect from the game's narrative and interactive gameplay systems.
In a massive interview with Dazed ahead of the release of Grand Theft Auto 6: An Extended Look, Rockstar Games confirmed a ton of new details, mainly about the game's co-protagonists Jason, revealed to be ex-military, and Lucia, an amateur fighter.
One of the main features discussed was the character-swapping system, an iconic GTA feature that allows players to "choose to either play as a couple, or go off and cause chaos independently," according to Dazed.
One scenario described finds Jason driving around, with Lucia in the passenger seat scrolling on the in-game phone that houses usable social media apps; players can switch between them seamlessly while they're together, or explore and complete missions individually.
"When the job inevitably goes wrong and spirals into a car chase, the fluid system enables players to take the wheel in one moment, then fire on pursuers out of the passenger window the next," Dazed said.
GTA 6 is the first game with a romantic pair as the co-leads, and according to Rupert Humphries, senior vice president of narrative at Rockstar, players can expect "a Bonnie and Clyde-type narrative" at the game's center.
The game will also offer plenty of customization, from clothing, hairstyles, tattoos, makeup, vehicles, and more, and it seems like Rockstar is also implementing features from Red Dead Redemption 2 with life-sim interactive systems that will affect how Lucia and Jason look.
Sign up for breaking news, reviews, opinion, top tech deals, and more.
For example, Jason and Lucia's weight can be affected by food, and "exercising visibly builds and tones their muscles." Additionally, if players let them spend a long time away from bed, on the run from police, or "on a multi-day bender," their appearances will take a toll.
While these features will give players a lot of freedom, both characters will still have complex identities within the story, with Rob Nelson, head of development and co-studio head at Rockstar North, explaining, "We want to enable as much self-expression as possible, without losing the essence of the characters."
He added, "The thing we love about this medium is the way these characters aren’t empty avatars that you can do whatever you want with. Their story becomes a journey you share with them."
GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5, Xbox Series X, and Series S. If you missed it, Netflix has confirmed the runtime for the upcoming extended look, and all footage shown will be captured on the base PlayStation 5.

articles.title: Samsung introduces Galaxy S26 FE with Horizontal Lock and FanCam
articles.text:
Samsung has unveiled the Galaxy S26 FE, its latest addition to the S26 family, and it comes with One UI 9 out of the box.
The S26 FE will support features like My FanCam, which was first introduced in Samsung’s latest foldables. This automatically tracks a selected person in the frame and keeps them centred. Super Steady with Horizontal Lock was first introduced with the S26 series and helps users capture smoother video, especially useful for filming fast-moving activities.
The device also features 3x optical zoom and offers a 12MP selfie camera. The S26 FE offers Photo Assist, letting you update images with natural language prompts. And Gemini Omni users can create and edit videos based on photos and videos from the Gallery.
The S26 FE also has AI features available on other Samsung handsets, including Now Brief, Now Nudge and Circle to Search with Google.
Additionally, it features a 4,900mAh battery with 45W charging support alongside a 6.7-inch display with up to a 120Hz refresh rate.
Other specs include a 12MP ultra-wide camera, a 50MP wide camera, and an 8MP telephoto shooter with 3x optical zoom. Further, it has an Exynos 2500 processor, 8GB of RAM and three storage options: 128GB, 256GB and 512GB.
It has IP68 water and dust resistance, and comes in Blueberry, Graphite and Pistachio.
We’re still waiting to learn about Canadian pricing and availability.

articles.title: Telekom stellt 1,3 Millionen Telefonanschlüsse um – und lässt Kunden kräftig draufzahlen
articles.text:
Telekom beendet klassisches Festnetz – doch die neuen Tarife sind überteuert
Heute gibt es immer noch mehr als 1,3 Millionen Telekom-Kund:innen, die einen Vertrag für einen reinen Telefonanschluss besitzen. Sie können entweder auf Internet verzichten oder bekommen den Zugang zum Netz über andere Wege. Doch das soll sich bald ändern. Wie Verivox berichtet, stellt die Telekom diese verbliebenen Anschlüsse jetzt endgültig um. Und das hat teils gravierende Auswirkungen auf die Preise.
Was Telekom-Kund:innen jetzt wissen müssen
Die Telekom bietet allen betroffenen Kund:innen, die keinen Kombivertrag mit Internet haben und bei ihrem reinen Telefonanschluss bleiben möchten, eine Lösung an. Sie können ihren Anschluss behalten, wenn sie zu einem neuen Tarif wechseln, der über Mobilfunk läuft. Damit die Festnetztelefone weiterhin genutzt und die alte Rufnummer beibehalten werden kann, muss eine Box zwischen Telefon und Telefonbuchse installiert werden. In der Box befindet sich eine SIM-Karte, die für den Zugang zum Mobilfunknetz sorgt.
Dieses System, das die Telekom als „Call Connect via Funk“ bezeichnet, kostet wahrscheinlich viele Kund:innen im Vergleich zum reinen Telefonvertrag mehr. Denn für die Box selbst werden entweder monatlich 3,95 Euro im Monat oder einmalig 100 Euro fällig. Richtig teuer wird es aber erst bei den gebotenen Tarifen. Die Standardvariante „Call Basic via Funk“ enthält monatlich 120 Freiminuten für Telefonate. Dafür werden 22,95 Euro fällig. Über die Freiminuten hinaus kostet jede Minute ins deutsche Festnetz 2,9 Cent und 19 Cent für das Mobilfunknetz.
Wer eine Flatrate haben möchte, um unbegrenzt telefonieren zu können, sollte laut Telekom „Call Comfort via Funk“ buchen. Damit sind zumindest alle Verbindungen ins deutsche Festnetz abgedeckt. Dafür zahlen Telekom-Kund:innen zusätzlich zur besagten Box 32,45 Euro im Monat. Die Telekom schreibt in einer Ankündigung dazu: „Für viele Menschen ist das Telefon ein wichtiger Teil ihres Alltags. Deshalb begleitet die Telekom die Umstellung sorgfältig. Das Ziel ist eine einfache Lösung, die zuverlässig funktioniert und die vertraute Nutzung erhält.“
Wie Verivox betont, können Telekom-Kund:innen deutlich sparen, wenn sie zu einem anderen Tarif wechseln. Bei anderen Anbietern gibt es Handytarife mit Allnet-Flat für etwa fünf Euro im Monat. Wer kein Smartphone hat und sich keines anschaffen will, kann auch Tischtelefone mit SIM‑Karten-Slot nutzen. Sie verbinden sich mit dem Mobilfunknetz, funktionieren aber wie Festnetzgeräte. Laut Verivox liegen die Kosten dafür meist unter 100 Euro. Wer bei der Telekom bleiben will, kann ebenfalls zu solchen Tarifen wechseln und noch etwa die Hälfte der Kosten sparen. Dort beginnen die Tarife ab etwa zehn Euro im Monat.

articles.title: Buried in Meta's $18B settlement is a legal pass on kids' data | TechCrunch
articles.text:
In addition to paying out up to $18 billion and adding child safety measures, Meta’s settlement agreement with attorneys general from 29 states includes an interesting provision: The states have agreed not to sue Meta under existing child safety laws over its retention and use of children’s data.
That permission is being granted for the limited purpose of training and testing Meta’s age-assurance model and includes guardrails, but it’s a curious policy decision to make in a case centered on child safety, and one that could be difficult to properly enforce.
As specified in the settlement agreement, Meta must develop, train, and begin testing a model designed to detect which users on Meta’s platforms are under the age of 13. This must be done within a year of the document’s effective date. (While the agreement doesn’t specify that the model has to be AI-based, Meta’s current age-detection tools are powered by AI technology.)
Under U.S. child safety law, COPPA (Children’s Online Privacy Protection Act) typically requires that websites and apps limit the collection and retention of children’s personal information. Meta’s settlement agreement says that Meta shouldn’t need to violate COPPA to train or implement its age-assurance models. However, the agreement also says that the state AGs have agreed “fully, finally, and forever” not to bring any past, present, or future COPPA claims — or claims under similar state laws — related to Meta’s use of children’s data.
The agreement makes clear that Meta can’t use data from users under age 13 for ad targeting, marketing, or algorithmic optimization.
Meta’s request for legal protection, and the state AGs’ willingness to grant it, isn’t unreasonable, says Philip N. Yannella, a partner at law firm Blank Rome and co-chair of its Privacy, Security & Data Protection practice. “These kinds of data minimization guardrails are pretty typical for privacy compliance: e.g., verifying compliance with deletion requests,” he said, though he noted a caveat: COPPA is a federal law primarily enforced by the FTC, not the states, so it’s unclear whether the FTC, which isn’t a party to this settlement, has separately agreed to the same compromise.
It can be difficult for companies to keep data technically and organizationally isolated from the rest of their systems. Yet Meta is being asked to do just that — to isolate its understanding of children’s behavior signals and other data and use it solely for detecting and removing under-13 users. Fortunately, an independent auditor will be involved in monitoring Meta’s compliance with the settlement so we don’t only have to rely on Meta’s word.
Policing this limitation could be complicated. The data could hypothetically feed into other Meta systems over time, or could raise questions over whether the data, signals, or insights derived from it are being used elsewhere within the company. What’s not clear from the agreement is what data Meta will retain for training the model, how much behavioral information that may include, or how long it will retain the data. We also don’t know how these models will change in the future as Meta meets the settlement’s terms.
Barring state AGs from raising COPPA or similar state-law claims over this use of children’s data in the future could complicate the legal avenues states can pursue if questions arise around how Meta is using the data.
That doesn’t prevent them from pursuing legal claims, notes Joshua Wurtzel, a partner at Schlam Stone & Dolan LLP. “If Meta uses the data outside those lines, the release and covenant not to sue don’t apply,” he said. But those legal disputes could still be complicated, since they’d hinge on whether Meta’s use of the data fell within the settlement’s terms.
Peter Jackson, a Data & IP attorney at Greenberg Glusker LLP, agrees, saying the carve-out here could “disincentivize future enforcement actions.”
“The Settlement Agreement’s age-assurance measures bear all the hallmarks of a heavy, and perhaps hasty, negotiation,” he says.
The decision also touches on a broader question that’s been coming up across the AI industry lately, especially as more AI agents are being developed to help consumers with various tasks. The systems often require significant access to users’ personal data to work well. Similarly, Meta may need deep insight into children’s use of social media in order to identify which accounts belong to young people.

articles.title: 'Toy Story 5' ya tiene fecha de estreno en Disney+
articles.text:
Disney+ por fin le ha puesto fecha de estreno a Toy Story 5 en streaming. La película es hasta ahora su mayor éxito en cines en 2026. En taquilla ha sobrepasado la barrera de los 1.000 millones de dólares, lo que la sitúa como el tercer mejor estreno del año. Ahora, tras arrasar en su paso por salas, ya es hora de que los fans puedan disfrutar de la nueva aventura de Woody, Buzz, Jessie y compañía desde el sofá de casa.
Toy Story 5 se estrenó en cines el pasado 19 de junio y, como era de esperar, muy pronto se confirmó su éxito. El filme continuó la estela de las entregas anteriores, arrastrando a millones de espectadores de todo el mundo a comprar su entrada. De hecho, es ya la película más taquillera de toda la saga, amasando 1.129 millones de dólares en la taquilla global.
Además, la cinta también ha contado con muy buenas valoraciones tanto por parte de la crítica como por el público general. En definitiva, Toy Story 5 se ha convertido en un nuevo triunfo para La Casa del Ratón, que espera llevarla a otro nivel en Disney+. Y es que todo apunta a que se colocará como uno de los títulos más vistos en la plataforma en el momento en que se estrene.
Fecha de estreno de Toy Story 5 en Disney+
Tal y como ha confirmado la compañía en una nota de prensa, Toy Story 5 se estrenará en Disney+ y Hulu el 23 de septiembre.
"Los juguetes están de vuelta. Esta vez, Buzz Lightyear, Woody, Jessie y el resto de la pandilla se enfrentan a un nuevo reto cuando conocen a Lilypad, una nueva tablet que llega con sus propias ideas disruptivas sobre lo que es mejor para Bonnie. ¿Volverá a ser lo mismo la hora de jugar?", reza la sinopsis oficial de Toy Story 5.
Date de alta en Disney+ ahora y ahorra gracias a la suscripción anual, con la que podrás disfrutar de todo su catálogo de series y películas. Acceso a los últimos estrenos, al catálogo de Star y ESPN* y a los mejores documentales de National Geographic.
*ESPN solo está disponible en Latinoamérica. Ahorro respecto a 12 meses de suscripción mensual.
Y es que, en la película, los juguetes tendrán que enfrentarse a la llegada de la tecnología a su hogar. Bonnie, niña solitaria pero apasionada por jugar a la antigua usanza, quedará hipnotizada al entrar en contacto con su Lilypad y las posibilidades que le ofrece para socializar y hacer amigas. Aunque esta realidad conlleva riesgos y problemas. Por lo que Jessie y compañía buscarán la manera de hacerle recordar a su niña la verdadera esencia de divertirse.

articles.title: Tech Decluttering Tips: Smarter Ways To Store Your Devices - Tech Guide
articles.text:
Clutter builds up quickly when old phones, unused monitors, and tangled charging cords pile up on desks or inside closets. Households accumulate piles of outdated gear without a clear plan for keeping or removing items.
Organizing these items frees up physical room and protects sensitive hardware from damage. Clear guidelines separate valuable gear from items ready for disposal.
Audit Your Electronics Collection
Every successful organizing project begins with a complete inventory of what you own. Empty every drawer, box, and shelf containing electronics into one central space. Group items by category, placing smartphones in one pile, cables in another, and desktop components together.
Deciding what stays inside your house comes down to available space and immediate storage needs. Renting drive-up storage units in Redbank provides a space solution when household closets become crowded with extra gear. Moving spare equipment out of main living areas keeps your home tidy and functional.
Evaluating each piece of hardware prevents unnecessary clutter from returning. Ask whether an item serves a current function or provides a real backup purpose. Sorting devices early makes the remaining preparation steps straightforward.
Apply The Ninety Day Rule To Unused Hardware
Decide what to keep with clear boundaries and realistic expectations about future use. Ask yourself if you used an item during the past 90 days and if you plan to use it during the next 90 days. Answering no to both questions indicates an item should be sold, donated, or put away.
Old hardware loses value when left sitting unused in drawers. Applying this timeline prevents drawers from turning into permanent resting spots for forgotten gadgets. Regular reviews keep your collection manageable.
Selling working gadgets gives hardware a second life with new owners. Donating equipment to schools or community centers helps others and clears space. Storing true items saves energy and effort later.
Prepare Batteries And Cables Before Boxing
Leaving batteries inside devices for long periods creates serious safety risks. Lithium-ion and alkaline cells degrade, leak corrosive chemicals, or swell up. Removing detachable batteries before boxing up equipment protects circuit boards from chemical destruction.
Cable management comes with simple steps to prevent plastic coatings from cracking. Avoid wrapping cords tightly around power bricks or bending wires sharply at connection points. Loose coils secured with soft hook-and-loop ties maintain wire flexibility and prevent internal breaks.
Labeling cords with colored tape saves hours of confusion in the future. Keeping matching power adapters with their corresponding devices prevents mixed-up chargers. Storing cords in small zip bags protects individual wires from tangling.
Control Climate Conditions For Long-Term Safety
Environmental factors wreck sensitive internal circuitry if storage conditions are poor. Keeping gear in spaces between 10 and 21 degrees Celsius with 50 and 55 percent relative humidity stops moisture damage. Storing hardware at least 15 centimeters off floors and away from windows avoids sudden temperature changes.
Direct sunlight causes plastics to turn brittle and degrades display screens. Basements and attics suffer from extreme heat or damp conditions, making them risky choices. Choosing a controlled spot guarantees hardware operates properly when powered on again.
Using silica gel packets inside storage containers absorbs excess moisture. Airtight plastic bins offer superior protection compared to thin cardboard boxes. Proper environmental controls prevent expensive internal rust on sensitive circuit boards.
Reduce E-Waste Responsibly Through Recycling
Throwing old screens or computers into standard trash bins harms local ecosystems. Global electronic waste creation is rising five times faster than documented recycling efforts. Choosing certified collection points prevents toxic metals from contaminating soil and groundwater supplies.
Many manufacturers offer trade-in programs for working items, offering store credit toward updated hardware. Local drop-off hubs process non-working components safely to extract reusable copper, gold, and aluminum. Clean disposal minimizes environmental impacts.
Researching local e-waste drop-off events turns disposal into an easy task. Many retailers accept old cables, dead batteries, and broken accessories free of charge. Responsible recycling keeps dangerous materials out of standard landfills.
Protect Personal Data Before Packing
Physical cleaning goes hand in hand with digital security before packing away any device. Erasing personal credentials and cloud accounts prevents unauthorized access to private data. Factory resets restore operating systems to clean starting slates.
- Back up photos and personal documents to secure cloud storage
- Sign out of all account profiles and digital storefronts
- Execute a full factory reset through system settings
- Label external storage drives with drive capacity and file contents
Organized storage bins make finding specific accessories effortless later on. Clear plastic totes paired with descriptive exterior labels keep components sorted by device type. Stacking labeled bins neatly simplifies access when you need a spare cable.
Proper organization transforms chaotic spaces into efficient environments. Taking time to sort, clean, and store hardware safeguards valuable gadgets and protects personal data. Clear habits lead to organized rooms and smooth device management.

articles.title: Starship : SpaceX dévoile de nouvelles images inédites de sa fusée géante en pleine mer
articles.text:
Au large de l’île Christmas, SpaceX continue ses opérations de récupération de sa fusée géante Starship. Dans un point d’étape partagé le 27 août 2026, l’entreprise américaine a mis en ligne de nouvelles images du Ship 40, cet exemplaire de l’étage supérieur du lanceur qui a survécu à la rentrée atmosphérique lors du treizième vol d’essai.
C’est une première pour le programme Starship : jamais un étage supérieur n’était revenu de l’espace en un seul morceau après son amerrissage. Les exemplaires précédents s’étaient disloqués ou avaient coulé peu après avoir touché l’eau. Ship 40, lui, est resté étanche et a flotté, ce qui a ouvert la porte à une récupération que SpaceX n’avait pas anticipée.
Les clichés publiés sur X (ex-Twitter) sont légèrement datés. Ils montrent l’étage en train de baigner dans l’océan Indien, toujours relié à un navire remorqueur par un câble, ce qui a servi à le tracter. Or, aux dernières nouvelles, le Ship 40 a finalement été chargé sur un bateau semi-submersible, afin de le sortir de la mer.
Pour l’équipe d’ingénierie de SpaceX qui a été dépêchée sur place, la sortie du Ship 40 hors de l’eau va largement faciliter son transport jusqu’aux États-Unis et son inspection, notamment de la partie immergée. Mais le fait est que ces vérifications ont été lancées bien avant, comme on le voit sur les photos : en effet, des techniciens ont été hissés sur le Ship 40 en pleine mer.
La récupération a viré au feuilleton. Après son amerrissage du 24 juillet, le Ship 40 a dérivé de plus de 400 kilomètres au gré des courants. Le 7 août, Elon Musk jugeait encore l’opération mal engagée. Ce n’est que le 18 août, après environ 24 jours passés en mer, que les navires de récupération sont parvenus à guider l’engin jusqu’aux eaux plus calmes de l’île Christmas.
Des tuiles extraites pour examen
« Les ingénieurs de SpaceX ont passé plusieurs jours à inspecter le vaisseau 40 au large de l’île Christmas. Ils ont prélevé des échantillons du bouclier thermique et ont acquis des informations essentielles sur la manière dont le vaisseau a géré sa rentrée atmosphérique, ce qui permettra d’apporter des améliorations aux futurs modèles », a écrit SpaceX.
Le bouclier thermique du Ship 40 est composé, rappelons-le, d’une couche formée par des milliers de tuiles céramiques hexagonales. Celles-ci, grâce à leurs propriétés mécaniques et thermiques particulières, permettent au Ship d’encaisser les températures extrêmes de la rentrée atmosphérique, et des contraintes physiques intenses causées par le contact avec l’air.
Sur les clichés, on voit les ingénieurs s’approcher de la coque avec des petites embarcations rapides ainsi qu’une échelle qui a été lancée par-dessus la structure pour permettre de grimper au sommet. On voit ainsi plusieurs personnes extraire des tuiles à différents endroits du Ship 40 – vers le nez, près des moteurs et aussi le long du cylindre.
Dans une seconde actualité, SpaceX a confirmé ensuite le chargement de l’engin sur le navire semi-submersible et le début du long voyage vers la base texane de l’entreprise – Starbase. Une odyssée qui prendra au bas mot plusieurs semaines. L’entreprise pourra ainsi procéder à des analyses encore plus poussées.

articles.title: Epic Games Store regala un nuevo juego de terror cooperativo para PC
articles.text:
Epic Games Store suma una nueva propuesta a su catálogo de juegos gratuitos y esta vez apuesta por el género de terror cooperativo. Los usuarios de la plataforma pueden reclamar sin costo Together After Dark, un título independiente que invita a la exploración y la supervivencia en grupo.
La oferta estará disponible hasta el 2 de septiembre a las 4:04 AM (hora peninsular española), momento en el que el juego volverá a su precio habitual. Aprovechar estas promociones es una tendencia en alza entre aficionados que buscan ampliar su biblioteca de PC sin desembolsar dinero.
PUBLICIDAD
Cuál es el nuevo juego de terror gratuito en Epic Games
Together After Dark se presenta como una aventura cooperativa para hasta cuatro jugadores. La premisa es clara: adentrarse en un bosque oscuro y peligroso, enfrentar fenómenos paranormales y sobrevivir a las amenazas que acechan en cada rincón.

articles.title: Meta Expands Its Custom Silicon Strategy From Compute Into Networking
articles.text:
Meta has detailed MTIA 300, its first in-house accelerator optimized for training ranking and recommendation models.
Unlike large-language-model training, where raw floating-point throughput is often the dominant concern, Meta says recommendation models spend much more time communicating between accelerators. MTIA 300 addresses that by integrating networking and collective communication directly into the chip.
The communication pressure comes largely from embedding tables, which Meta says can contain more than 99% of a recommendation model’s parameters. Training these models across hundreds of accelerators generates frequent AllReduce, AllToAll, and AllGather operations, creating a workload where the network can become as important as the compute itself.
Meta first moved the network interface into the accelerator package. MTIA 300 contains two network chiplets with six custom 800 Gbps RDMA NICs each, providing 1.2 TB/s of total I/O bandwidth without crossing a PCIe bus. The same twelve NICs support both scale-up communication within a rack and scale-out traffic between racks, allowing Meta to change how bandwidth is divided without redesigning the chip.
Source: Meta
Moving the NICs closer to compute did not remove another source of contention: on conventional GPUs, collective communication can consume the same processing resources needed for training. MTIA 300 instead includes 16 dedicated message engines that handle communication independently of its main compute grid, including near-memory hardware for reduction operations.
Meta reports that this separation allows large matrix operations and collective communication to run concurrently with less than 0.5% degradation in compute throughput. On the GPU architecture used for comparison, Meta measured degradation of more than 20% when the two workloads overlapped.
The hardware was co-designed with HCCL, Meta’s collective-communication library. Rather than having the host CPU orchestrate every communication operation while a job runs, HCCL compiles collective operations into subgraphs that MTIA 300’s message engines can execute autonomously. Once those instructions reach the accelerator, the host is no longer involved in driving the communication.
In production, Meta says HCCL reaches up to 940 GB/s of communication bandwidth within a rack. On a 150-billion-parameter recommendation model running across 40 accelerators, the company reports that MTIA 300 reduced total communication time by 3.9x compared with an equivalent GPU cluster.
MTIA 300 also marks an expansion of Meta’s broader custom-silicon programme. The company says it already operates hundreds of thousands of MTIA accelerators for inference and plans four further generations over the next two years, spanning ranking, recommendation, and generative-AI workloads. Meta has also expanded its partnership with Broadcom to co-develop future MTIA generations, while continuing to source accelerators from AMD, NVIDIA, and other vendors as part of what it calls a portfolio strategy.
That strategy reflects a wider shift among hyperscalers toward workload-specific AI silicon. Google has continued expanding its TPU programme, Amazon has grown its Trainium business, and Microsoft is developing successive generations of Maia accelerators as cloud providers look for alternatives to relying exclusively on general-purpose GPUs.
MTIA 300 shows how far Meta is prepared to take that specialization. Rather than treating networking as supporting infrastructure around the accelerator, the company designed compute, communication hardware, and collective software together around a workload where moving data can be as important as processing it.

articles.title: Lidl investit 5,6 milliards d'euros dans l'IA pour défier les géants américains
articles.text:
Lidl investit 5,6 milliards d'euros dans l'IA pour défier les géants américains
Quand on parle de Lidl, on pense tout naturellement aux courses pas chères. Mais le roi du low cost a d'autres ambitions et investit 5,6 milliards d'euros dans un projet pour le moins ambitieux : un centre de données IA pour s'émanciper de la domination étasunienne.
C'est officiel, Lidl (enfin, sa maison mère Schwarz) investissent 5,6 milliards d'euros dans un centre de données en Allemagne. On parle d'une capacité de 240 mégawatts, avec comme objectif de proposer une solution européenne face aux leaders étasuniens du cloud. Mais le premier serveur ne tournera pas avant plusieurs années.
La maison mère de Lidl investit dans l'IA
Le site où se trouvera ce centre de données IA se trouve à Dummerstorf, près de Rostock, dans le Mecklembourg-Poméranie-Occidentale. C'est l'année prochaine que les travaux commenceront sur ce terrain où l'on attend 120 emplois. Puis en 2033, la puissance raccordée atteindra 240 mégawatts, soit la consommation moyenne de 600 000 foyers. En 2045, une seconde phase pourrait monter à 1 gigawatt.
Gerd Chrzanowski, PDG de la maison mère de Lidl, appelée Schwarz, a justifié cet investissement lors de la présentation. "La souveraineté numérique ne naît pas d'appels ni de discours. Elle naît de l'action, d'infrastructures fiables et d'applications utilisables au quotidien", explique Gerd Chrzanowski. Le PDG du groupe Schwarz précise que si ce terrain a été choisi, c'est pour sa taille, puisque suffisamment grand pour bâtir un très grand centre de données.
Le groupe Schwarz possède Lidl et Kaufland, avec 604 000 employés dans le monde et un chiffre d'affaires de 185,6 milliards d'euros. Et le groupe n'est pas étranger au numérique, puisque la division informatique Schwarz Digits propose déjà des services de cloud sous la marque Stackit et de la cybersécurité avec XM Cyber.
La branche Schwarz Digits a même réalisé 2,2 milliards d'euros de chiffre d'affaires sur l'exercice clos en février, soit une hausse de 16 % sur un an. C'est notamment la demande de solutions de cloud qui a apporté cette croissance spectaculaire.
Un autre centre de données IA au programme
Schwarz confirme aussi qu'un autre centre de données IA sera bâti à Lübbenau, dans le Brandebourg. La facture atteint 11 milliards d'euros pour ce site, soit deux fois la somme pour Rostock. Le groupe à la tête de Lidl se positionne donc comme concurrent direct d'Amazon Web Services et de Microsoft Azure en Europe.
On le sait, les centres de données sont catastrophiques d'un point de vue écologique. Autant en termes d'eau consommé que de pollution sonore et visuelle. Vous vous en doutez, Schwarz tente de rassurer en expliquant que l'usine tournera avec des énergies renouvelables en régime normal.
Le groupe assure notamment que le refroidissement passera par un circuit fermé pour limiter la consommation d'eau. Manuela Schwesig, ministre-présidente du Mecklembourg-Poméranie-Occidentale, annonce aussi des discussions avec la ville de Rostock pour récupérer la chaleur produite et chauffer des logements.
L'Allemagne a besoin de renforcer son bouclier numérique. Il faut dire que les entreprises là-bas signalent une hausse des menaces informatiques de services de renseignement étrangers. La dépendance aux géants étasuniens inquiète aussi Berlin. "Nous avons raté le coche sur toute la question des plateformes de réseaux sociaux, nous ne devons pas maintenant rater l'occasion de suivre notre propre voie ici en Allemagne", a déclaré Manuela Schwesig.

articles.title: Dead by Daylight Switches to Denuvo Anti-Cheat—Steam Deck and Linux Support Remains
articles.text:
Thursday, August 27th 2026
	
		
	
	
	
Dead by Daylight Switches to Denuvo Anti-Cheat—Steam Deck and Linux Support Remains
Dead by Daylight, the co-op survival horror game from Behaviour Interactive, will soon switch from Easy Anti-Cheat to Denuvo Anti-Cheat as a trial following a recent community survey, according to a recent announcement by the game studio on the game's Steam Store page. One of the biggest takeaways from the community survey was that players felt that the studio "could be doing more" in order to curb cheating in the online game. As such, it plans to temporarily switch anti-cheat providers in order to determine the effectiveness of an alternative solution. 
Currently, Dead by Daylight uses Easy Anti-Cheat with Linux compatibility mode enabled, but on September 2, the Steam version of the game will switch to Denuvo as part of what it is calling the Anti-Cheat Trials. The idea is to test alternative anti-cheat systems, and the developer encourages players to play the game normally and report cheaters as they would usually. The game will automatically prompt players to install Denuvo Anti-Cheat when the trial starts, and players will not be able to access the game without installing it.
Following the Anti-Cheat Trials, Denuvo Anti-Cheat will automatically be deactivated and no longer run on player systems, although it's unclear how long the trials will last. Players will be allowed to uninstall Denuvo after the trials are complete, and Behaviour Interactive will provide a support page walking players through removing Denuvo from their PCs following the deactivation.
The studio is careful to note that it will not be testing the controversial Denuvo DRM software, and that the change to Denuvo Anti-Cheat will not affect Steam Deck compatibility. Cross-play will also remain unaffected by the switch to Denuvo, even though the trials are exclusive to the Steam version of the game.
We're continuously testing the compatibility and performance of each anti-cheat provider to ensure you have a seamless experience. Compatibility with Steam Deck and Proton has been tested and will continue to be supported.

articles.title: Can you make money online with lead generation?
articles.text:
Can you make money online with lead generation?
And do businesses still pay for this service?
A few years ago, it felt like every day there was some new influencer going on about all the money you can make running lead generation for different businesses. But with AI tools in the mix, it takes very little to set up a lead generation workflow by yourself. So the question is, do people still pay for this?
In a word, yes.
But if you’re getting into lead generation in 2026, you’re approaching a crowded market with a lot of conflicting advice to sort through. Read on for a clear idea of exactly what lead generation as a service looks like in 2026, what it’s like to set up a modern workflow by cobbling together AI models and vendor APIs, what investments need to be made, and how much you can expect to charge.
How does lead generation work in 2026?
Lead generation has always been a numbers game.
Sales teams don’t always have the resources to follow up on every person who could be a potential customer. But they also don’t want to lose business to bigger competitors with more established sales processes. As a consultant, you step in to handle lead generation on a company’s behalf, reaching out to lots of people and filtering out a few qualified leads that you can then pass on to the sales team.
While the core function hasn’t changed, the way lead generation is handled today has changed quite a bit.
AI can write emails and send follow-ups on autopilot. Chatbots can answer common sales questions without human intervention from the business. Even voice or video calls get transcribed, summarized, and analyzed for key objections and pressure points.
Sign up to the TechRadar Pro newsletter to get all the top news, opinion, features and guidance your business needs to succeed!
At the same time, many customers are lukewarm about the idea of being handed off to a chatbot. They want businesses to listen and pay attention to their concerns before recommending a service. This creates friction that most companies or consultants aren’t equipped to handle well.
Do companies still pay for lead generation?
Surprisingly, business spending on lead generation has only grown, not shrunk. In fact, the global lead generation industry is expected to reach a $295 billion valuation by 2027. Even with all the AI platforms, chatbots, and automation tools at their disposal, many businesses still rely on external vendors to handle lead generation for them.
That said, businesses are now a lot pickier about which lead generation service they use. Unless you can offer genuine value by supplying high-quality leads that often turn into long-term customer relationships, you won’t earn a lot of money or retain enough clients to do this for a living.
Where does AI factor in?
AI platforms like ChatGPT and Claude can help you draft personalized messages for customer outreach. More powerful autonomous agents can even build you a list of prospects, collect data on their demographics and preferences, find verified contact details, and initiate contact with them without any human involvement at all. Customer-facing chatbots on websites can answer common queries and address objections before handing them off to a sales agent.
All of these things are designed to make it easier for smaller sales teams to scale up their operations without bringing in outside help. But they also have blind spots. For example, contact details need to be validated before campaign launch to avoid spam reports. Even the best data enrichment tools can make mistakes. AI-generated messages work well enough for large-scale outreach during initial contact, but once a lead has expressed interest, they will expect to speak to a human being who can give them more personalized attention.
Setting up a typical lead generation workflow, step-by-step
Whether you’re doing lead generation in-house for a company or as an outsourced consultant, balancing automated workflows with the right amount of human attention is how you get the most fruitful leads in the shortest amount of time. Here’s what a good lead generation workflow in 2026 looks like:
Step 1: Lead sourcing
First, you need to build a list. At this stage, it doesn’t have to be a very good list, because your priority is to capture as many contacts as may be interested in your business’ products or services.
Most startups and small businesses source leads from existing databases that list contacts like an old-school phonebook. They’re not very accurate, but that’s alright because you’ll be running your own checks to make sure the information is high quality and up to date.
If you’re targeting working professionals, many apps offer to source leads for you directly from LinkedIn. If your customer base belongs to a specific industry or niche, smaller but more targeted public databases may also be available. You can also source leads through forms and surveys, whether captured through your own website and social accounts or bought off a third-party data broker.
Step 2: Enrichment
Once you have a list, you’ll need to perform additional checks to make sure all the customer data you have is up to date and their contact information is still active. Data enrichment tools scan publicly available social media accounts, websites, and yellow page listings to fill in missing information like email addresses, phone numbers, current job titles, addresses, and interests.
These tools usually bill you per credit, so you’ll be paying a subscription fee each month and then an additional fee if your credit usage exceeds your subscribed plan’s quota.
Step 3: Lead qualification and scoring
After you’ve got an updated list of leads with verified demographic and contact data, you can use lead scoring systems to qualify high-quality prospects using AI. Depending on a lead’s demographics, online activity, employment history, etc., a lead scoring app will assign a number that tells you how likely they are to convert into a customer, which can guide the way you prioritize your efforts.
Many lead sourcing and data enrichment platforms have basic AI scoring already built in. But to properly qualify a lead before you hand them off to a business’ internal sales team, you’ll have to initiate contact based on likelihood of interest and track the way each lead interacts with your campaigns through email open rates, website click-throughs, responses, etc.
Step 4: Email sequencing
This works in tandem with Step 3, because lead scoring is an ongoing process rather than a one-off. Most people don’t want to get on a call to discuss a purchase at first contact, so you’ll need to get them to warm up to you through personalized emails, offers, and maybe even a newsletter.
You can sequence a chain of AI-generated emails using a lead’s demographic data, then track their interactions over time until they seem ready to speak to a human salesperson. This reduces the chances of wasting time on uninterested prospects, keeping your efforts focused on the leads who matter.
Once a lead feels sufficiently warmed up, you step in and offer to book a call for them with the company’s sales department. For smaller purchases, you can even send them a direct purchase link with a compelling offer that encourages them to act, but high-value purchases require a bit more convincing.
Step 5: Scheduling
Scheduling tools can help you avoid back-and-forth by sending a calendar link to your prospect to book a call with the sales team during available working hours. These apps typically cost less than $20/month, which makes them one of the cheaper tools in your lead generation stack. They integrate directly with platforms like Google Calendar, which makes it easier to track upcoming conversations.
Step 6: CRM sync
Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software is the glue that holds a company’s sales and support activities together. There are almost no modern businesses that don’t have a CRM, since it’s an extremely convenient way to keep track of your conversations with customers before, during, and after sales.
If you’re offering lead generation as a service, synchronizing all your sourcing, qualification, and outreach activities into a CRM makes it easy for clients to gauge the level of value you’re offering from a single UI. Most popular CRM platforms also let you export custom reports of your lead generation activity for clients to review, if you’d rather not have your entire workflow on display for them.
CRMs are priced per user, so they are pretty inexpensive for independent consultants and small teams. You may even want to try out a free option first to see if a paid plan is worth the investment at this stage. Regardless, this is an essential piece of software that costs very little to set up and makes it much easier to run large-scale lead gen campaigns without losing track of all your progress with customers.
How much does it cost?
A single-operator lead generation stack with all the above functions built-in won’t set you back more than $150 to $400 a month. Many of these platforms also offer bundled packages so you get multiple lead generation features like contact list management and email sequencing from a single platform.
That said, depending on the number of contacts or data fields you’re looking up each month, costs can scale significantly. Data enrichment tools charge you a usage fee based on the number of contacts or data fields you need to look up, which can exceed several hundred dollars in initial setup to build a quality dataset that you can then run your campaign off of for the next several months.
Make sure to price your services so that you can achieve at least 15% to 30% in annual profit margins after factoring in all software and labor costs. It’s also a good idea to look into volume and performance-based pricing models if your work involves generating a high volume of leads or if each prospect is considered a long-term or high-value engagement.
How to charge for lead generation in 2026
Fee structures and rates can swing wildly from one extreme to the other depending on the kind of clients you serve and what they’re willing to pay for a lead. That said, it’s not unheard of for a successful lead generation agency to charge upwards of $5,000 a month for an entry-level engagement if the leads are high value. But not everyone charges a flat monthly retainer because there are a lot of different payment structures you can experiment with.
| Model | How it works | Typical rate | Best for | 
| Pay-per-lead | You charge a fixed amount for each lead delivered | Roughly $30 to several hundred dollars, depending on industry and qualification criteria | Simple to sell, but puts all the pressure on lead quality | 
| Retainer or flat fee | Clients pay a consistent monthly rate for ongoing work, regardless of volume delivered | $2,000 to $10,000 a month for a small to mid-sized programme | Predictable income, but requires regular reporting to justify the fee | 
| Performance-based or revenue share | Your fee ties to outcomes, like a share of closed revenue or a fee per qualified meeting | Roughly $150 to $600 per booked meeting for mainstream programmes | Appeals to cautious clients, but hard to price without a proven track record | 
| Hybrid | A reduced base retainer compared to your usual rate, but with performance bonuses attached on top | Varies by client and target | The safest middle ground for most people starting out | 
Ritoban Mukherjee is a tech and innovations journalist from West Bengal, India. These days, most of his work revolves around B2B software, such as AI website builders, VoIP platforms, and CRMs, among other things. He has also been published on Tom's Guide, Creative Bloq, IT Pro, Gizmodo, Quartz, and Mental Floss.

articles.title: Here’s how Bell’s fastest 5G+ network keeps up with Canadians
articles.text:
Most of us don’t think twice about what our devices are doing at any given moment. You might be scrolling social media, uploading photos, messaging friends, streaming music, and checking directions, all while connected to the same network.
Behind the scenes, those activities require a constant flow of data. As experiences like video streaming, cloud gaming, video calls, and AI-powered apps become more common, wireless networks need to handle more data and more connected devices than ever before.
Having a robust 5G network speed and reliable mobile network performance is important — Canadians need a network that can keep up wherever they are.
That’s where Bell, aka Canada’s Fastest 5G+ Network*, comes into play to help customers access faster wireless performance for the activities they rely on every day.
Canada’s Fastest 5G+ Network
You don’t need to be a network expert to know when your phone is slow — videos keep buffering or uploads take longer than expected. That’s why independent organizations test mobile networks to measure things like speed and performance in the real world.
Bell’s 5G+ network was recently recognized by independent network analyst Rohde & Schwarz SwissQual AG, earning top rankings for both 5G+ and 5G data speed performance.
The recognition adds to Bell’s growing list of network accolades, following the recent Ookla Awards, where Bell was named Canada’s Fastest and Best 5G Network.
What does that mean for you? Well, for Bell customers, that means faster speeds, more consistent connectivity, and an overall better experience.
Stronger performance
Award-winning speeds are only part of the story. With more consistent connectivity in busy urban areas and crowded events, customers can stay connected even when network demand is high — like when you’re posting videos from a festival or following the action at a major sporting event.
The Bell 5G+ network has been specially designed to perform during these major events. Just look at how it performed during the FIFA World Cup 2026™ — it carried 330 TB of wireless data traffic across Canadian matches and official fan zones. For fans, that meant being able to stream, share, message, and stay connected even in crowded environments where network demand was especially high.
The same focus extends to recent major events such as Osheaga and the Cavendish Beach Music Festival, where Bell’s network teams helped support the connectivity demands that come with thousands of attendees posting, streaming, and sharing content in real time.
Building for what’s next
Today’s mobile networks do much more than support streaming and video calls. They’re helping power the next generation of connected experiences, from AI-powered applications and immersive content to cloud gaming.
To prepare for these evolving demands, Bell continues to advance its network capabilities through enhancements including 5G+ Advanced and next-generation wireless technologies.
And, its focus on innovation goes beyond delivering fast network speeds. Features like AI-powered Suspicious Call Detection help customers avoid potential spam and fraud calls, while ongoing investments in Bell’s 5G+ network support the connected experiences Canadians rely on every day.
Learn more about Bell 5G+ and experience it all for yourself.
*Fastest 5G+ Network based on 5G/5G+ Network Performance Score, calculated by Rohde & Schwarz from data collected in Canada comparing data-only performance of other national wireless networks in 2026. 5G+ results are defined as connectivity while actively using 3500 MHz / 3800 MHz spectrum.
